Sniper bots settle longer: bot_aim_settle_secs 0.5 (was 0.3), and bot_aim_settle_secs_min (0.2) - while the gun can't fire (shot cooldown, the bolt, a reload) the settle does not grow and stays below what the minimum leaves, so every shot waits at least that long (times the difficulty's mult) after the gun is ready again. Counted from the shot it changed nothing - the rifles' own cooldowns are 230-600 ms. HARD bots on de_silo with snipers only: Hunter shots at least 1.25 s apart.

Every arena load draws a random rng_offset added to all the mode's seeds (the round seed - generated bot waypoints, spawn shuffle, variations - the stable round rng, team scrambling): rounds started on the same step, e.g. a server's first round or rounds that all end with the time, repeated the same waypoints and choices. The server draws it in rechoose_arena and sends it in the public vars (arena_rng_offset; clients reload the arena when it changes), a client joining mid-match gets it with the mode state; the editor's playtest draws its own. 30 bits, so seeds stay positive in the editor. Tested: two server starts - different seeds, the client the same as the server, a client joining mid-round - 0 desyncs. Editor playtest: each round's waypoint seed goes to the Preview seed (with a message), so "Same seed" shows exactly the waypoints the round generated (checked: same count and positions). A playtest leaves out what the game would - the random_waypoints preview layer, and the author's waypoints in RANDOM_EVERY_ROUND.
